10:00 — Air filtration system maintenance: finished on time.

17:30 — Delayed video call with his family (recorded messages). 9-min recorded message, smiles.
19:30 — Shared dinner. Kelly: “Ito, will you show me your fix on the pump?”
21:00 — Movie night with the crew, comments on the film.
